Project Title: Abandoned, But Not Forgotten — Interplanetary Heritage (1950–2026)
About Us & Vision: We are a passionate space-tech initiative dedicated to transforming how humanity perceives extraterrestrial hardware. Instead of viewing leftover lunar and Martian modules, landers, and rovers as mere "debris," we treat them as our solar system’s first archaeological artifacts and sacred interplanetary heritage.
What We Are Building: An immersive 3D interactive web.
